newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse CBS unit declines comment.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse CBS unit declines comment.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS unit declined comment on a report that Westinghouse will shortly announce a plan to spin off its industrial assets and focus on CBS and other broadcasting operations.
"I am unable to comment," said a CBS spokesman, in response to the report in the Wall Street Journal.

The newspaper, quoting unnamed people close to the situation, said the company's board was expected to meet on the plan Tuesday and the company would then announce the spinoff Wednesday. A Westinghouse official was not immediately available for comment.
